name: @jeswr/solid-places
description: Generated private places, visits and journeys with a bounded, pure Google Timeline importer.

scripts.build: pnpm --workspace-root exec tsc -p packages/solid-places/tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-generated.mjs
scripts.codegen: node node_modules/@jeswr/federation-codegen/dist/cli.js gen --ontology codegen/places.ontology.ttl --shapes codegen/places.shapes.ttl --config codegen.config.json --out src/generated
scripts.lint: pnpm --workspace-root exec biome check packages/solid-places/src packages/solid-places/scripts packages/solid-places/test packages/solid-places/codegen.config.json packages/solid-places/package.json
